name: workflow-engine
description: Structured workflow engine for Claude Code. Enforces phased development (consult → brainstorm → plan → implement → verify → capture → retrospective → finalize) with mechanical gates, evidence tracking, and session state persistence. Supports 5 flow types: micro, light, debug, full, explore.

src_paths.description: Comma-separated source paths relative to repo root (e.g. backend/src,frontend/src). Default: src

test_paths.description: Comma-separated test paths relative to repo root (e.g. backend/tests). Default: tests

test_command.description: Command to run tests (e.g. php vendor/bin/phpunit, npm test). Default: npm test

lint_command.description: Command to run linter (e.g. make lint, npm run lint). Default: npm run lint

specs_path.description: Path for spec documents relative to repo root. Default: docs/specs

plans_path.description: Path for plan documents relative to repo root. Default: docs/plans

execution_logs_path.description: Path for execution logs relative to repo root. Default: docs/execution-logs

decisions_log.description: Path to decision log file relative to repo root. Default: docs/decisions/log.md
